strategic_thesis: The proposed project focuses on energy storage and grid modernization in Brooklyn, NY, which does not align with the geothermal and reservoir thermal energy storage focus of the funding opportunity. The solicitation is targeted towards geothermal technologies and high-temperature tools, which are not part of the proposed project's scope.
criteria_strengths: The project involves demonstration and pilot activities, which align with the FOA's emphasis on technology validation and demonstration.
The focus on deployment and software & controls could potentially contribute to strategic project goals aligned with emission reduction milestones.
potential_risks_or_flags: The project's TRL of 6 may not align with the FOA's focus on high-temperature geothermal technologies.
The estimated total budget of $15,000,000 exceeds the FOA's maximum award of $10,000,000.
The project's focus on electricity and grid modernization does not match the geothermal and RTES focus of the FOA.
recommended_positioning: Emphasize any potential synergies between energy storage technologies and geothermal applications, if applicable, to explore possible alignment.
